Title: Aarav and the Family

Cast

1. Aarav - 12 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Pallavi - 42 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Rajesh - 38 years, father
Look: light beard, green T-shirt

Places

1. The park - green grass, swings, benches

Scene 1: The park - Day

[Aarav stands in the park. Pallavi and Rajesh stand near him.]

Aarav: "Today feels like a good day."

[Aarav swings on the swing.]

Rajesh: "Pallavi, look at this."

[Aarav plays with his dog.]

Rajesh (excited): "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
